plan.title: Fitness Programme Impact Report
plan.subtitle: Comparative analysis of physical performance from baseline to endline

panels.title: Total Participants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT "Child ID" FROM endline)

panels.title: Avg Sit-ups Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups") AS improvement FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Average Shuttle Run Improvement by Location
panels.sql: SELECT b.Location, AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") AS time_saved FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Gender Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT Gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM (SELECT Gender FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT Gender FROM endline) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Top Performers: Sit-up Growth
panels.sql: SELECT b."Child name" AS name, b.Location, (e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups") AS growth FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" ORDER BY growth DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
The fitness programme has successfully engaged {{p1}} unique participants. Our primary metric for physical endurance, sit-ups, showed an average increase of {{p2}} repetitions per child across the cohort.

Performance gains were observed across various regions, with the most significant improvements in shuttle run times occurring in specific locations as shown in the regional breakdown. The programme maintains a diverse participant base across genders.

Detailed individual progress is captured in the top performers table, highlighting those who demonstrated the highest level of physical adaptation during the programme duration.
